title: Emergence of Statistical Financial Factors by a Diffusion Process
abstract: arXiv:2604.12197v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Factor models characterize the joint behavior of large sets of financial assets through a smaller number of underlying drivers. We develop a network-based framework in which factors emerge naturally from the structure of interactions among assets rather than being imposed statistically. The market is modeled as a system of coupled iterated maps, where assets' return depends on its own past returns and those of related assets. Effectively modeling the influence of irrational traders whose decisions are based on the past movements of a collection of stocks. The interaction structure between stock returns is defined by a coupling matrix derived from an orthogonal transformation of a Laplacian matrix that gradually links initially isolated clusters into a fully connected network. translated_title: 通过扩散过程涌现的统计金融因子
translated_abstract: 摘要：因子模型通过较少数量的潜在驱动因素来描述大量金融资产的联合行为。我们开发了一个基于网络的框架，其中因子从资产间相互作用的结构中自然涌现，而非统计上强加。市场被建模为耦合迭代映射的系统，其中资产的回报取决于其自身过去的回报及相关资产的回报。该模型有效刻画了基于一组股票过去走势做出决策的非理性交易者的影响。股票回报之间的相互作用结构由耦合矩阵定义，该矩阵源自拉普拉斯矩阵的正交变换，逐步将最初孤立的聚类连接成完全连接的网络。在这种结构下，稳定的协同运动模式出现，并可被解释为金融因子。初始聚类与最终涌现因子之间的关系也得到了探讨。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于网络扩散过程的因子模型，使金融因子从资产间相互作用结构中自然涌现，而非统计强加。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a network-based diffusion process factor model where financial factors emerge naturally from asset interaction structures rather than being statistically imposed.
